Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 108: April 2010
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #108 shipped to subscribers in March 2010 (bearing the cover date of April 2010 for Issue 108). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #108 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Fairytale Fights (hack-and-slash action-adventure)
Just Cause 2 (open-world action-adventure)
Prison Break: The Conspiracy (action-adventure stealth)
Scrap Metal (Xbox Live Arcade top-down combat racing)
Rayman 2: The Great Escape (Xbox Live Arcade classic platformer port)
Room Boomer (Xbox Live Arcade physics puzzle)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for Gears of War 3, Fallout: New Vegas, and Halo: Reach, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
